findings.evidence: 'Rank the survivors by the user's stated priorities; default order is spelling reliability, then memorability, then descriptiveness, then TLD fit.' The process pattern has no explicit checkpoint between generating names, looking them up and building the table.
findings.fix: Add one gate sentence to step 5 without removing anything: 'Do not build the Output table until every shortlisted candidate has exactly one of the three labels and, if checked, a source and UTC time.' This makes the generate-screen-lookup-report sequence a checked process.

findings.evidence: Two eval ids do not match their prompts: id 'casual-climate-names' is an energy-tracking app prompt, and 'short-ai-names' is a Spanish-English language-learning prompt. Also, 'sample-shortlist-honesty' lists 'references/example.md' as an input file, although eval inputs belong in evals/files/.
findings.fix: Rename the ids to match their prompts, for example 'casual-energy-app-names' and 'bilingual-language-app-names'. Drop the skill's own reference file from the sample eval's `files`; the skill loads it itself, and the eval should test that it does.

findings.evidence: '| `429`, `5xx`, `000` (no connection) or a timeout | `unverified`; stop querying, no retry |'. The scope of 'stop querying' is unclear. references/example.md keeps querying rdap.org for snipply.io after a 429 from pubapi.registry.google, so an agent cannot tell whether a 429 halts all lookups or only that server.
findings.fix: Change the cell to '`unverified`; stop querying that server for the rest of the session, no retry; lookups to other registry servers may continue'. This matches what references/example.md shows.
